name: Guidelicious
source:
Time to wake up...

A strange room.

A mysterious man.

Why are you here?

Let Him be your Guide.

[From [url=https://tymedust.itch.io/guidelicious]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
该醒醒了……

陌生的房间。

神秘的男人。

你为何身处此地？

让“他”来担任你的向导吧。

[摘自[url=https://tymedust.itch.io/guidelicious]itch.io[/url]]
